title: QUIZ - 06
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Compare two fractions with different denominators to determine which is greater
questions.question: Which fraction is greater: \( \frac{3}{10} \) or \( \frac{6}{7} \)?
questions.explanation: Converting to a common denominator or to decimals: \( \frac{3}{10} \) = 0.3000 and \( \frac{6}{7} \) = 0.8571. Since 0.8571 is larger, \( \frac{6}{7} \) is the greater fraction.
questions.hint: Convert both fractions to a common denominator or to decimals before comparing.

questions.learningObjective: Compare two fractions with different denominators to determine which is greater

questions.hint: Convert both fractions to a common denominator or to decimals before comparing.

questions.learningObjective: Order a set of fractions with unlike denominators from least to greatest
questions.question: Order these fractions from least to greatest: \( \frac{1}{8}, \frac{2}{3}, \frac{4}{7} \)
questions.explanation: Converting each fraction to a decimal makes the order clear: \(\frac{1}{8} = 0.125, \frac{2}{3} = 0.667, \frac{4}{7} = 0.571\). Ordering these decimals from least to greatest gives \( \frac{1}{8}, \frac{4}{7}, \frac{2}{3} \).
questions.hint: Convert every fraction to a decimal (or a common denominator) so they can be compared directly.

questions.concept: Representing Fractions from Parts of a Whole
questions.learningObjective: Represent a shaded region of a figure as a fraction
questions.question: A figure is divided into 12 equal parts, and 4 of them are shaded. Which fraction represents the shaded portion?
questions.explanation: The fraction representing a shaded region is the number of shaded parts over the total number of equal parts: 4 out of 12 gives \( \frac{1}{3} \).
questions.hint: A fraction represents shaded parts over total equal parts.
